status: In progress. User requires ALL roadmap items ready before any live deployment.

phases.name: Make the existing work trustworthy
phases.goal: Repair misleading status, broken handoffs and incomplete setup before adding more features.
phases.exit: Deposit readiness agrees with payments; record links open the correct record; failed saves and emails explain how to recover.

phases.name: Connect every record
phases.goal: Use one customer identity and explicit relationships from inquiry through final payment.
phases.exit: A user can follow a complete customer → quote → job → invoice journey and return without losing context.

phases.name: Make daily work simpler
phases.goal: Put the next useful action ahead of reports, advanced settings and long lists.
phases.exit: Common owner tasks require fewer decisions; every work item has a clear owner, status and next step.

phases.name: Make phones excellent in the field
phases.goal: Apply phone standards to every phase, then complete field and design workflows.
phases.exit: All critical journeys pass on physical iPhone and Android devices, with the keyboard open and a weak connection.

phases.name: Make money and materials understandable
phases.goal: Explain contract value, billing, collections, labor and stock without contradictory totals.
phases.exit: Every total has a definition and drill-through; partial payments, receipts and reversals reconcile.

phases.name: Connect growth to completed work
phases.goal: Turn website data, requests and customer communication into trackable outcomes.
phases.exit: A website request and its files can be followed through the resulting job and revenue; missing analytics stays visibly unknown.

phases.name: Keep it fast, reliable and maintainable
phases.goal: Expand existing quality gates, measure performance and remove only proven obsolete code.
phases.exit: Releases pass connected journeys, permission checks, phone checks and recovery tests with a documented rollback.

backlog.title: Recognize paid deposits correctly
backlog.problem: A paid standalone deposit invoice can leave Today asking to confirm a deposit.
backlog.change: Normalize deposit obligations and allocations across separate deposit invoices and deposits on full invoices; preserve historical financial entries.
backlog.acceptance: Paid, partial, refunded, voided and overpaid examples produce the same readiness in Today, Jobs and Schedule.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Make every record link go to the right place
backlog.problem: Saved quotes label a lead link “Open job”; customer history also leaves jobs and leads as plain text.
backlog.change: Open the actual linked job, or label the action “Open lead”; add direct links to connected history rows.
backlog.acceptance: Each label matches its destination; Back restores the original search, filters and position.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Open issued quotes without draft conflicts
backlog.problem: An unrelated conflicted draft can interrupt opening a saved quote.
backlog.change: Separate read-only issued-quote viewing from draft editing; preserve the previous draft; consume a deep link only after the target opens.
backlog.acceptance: With a stale local draft, opening another quote shows the requested quote without overwriting either version.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Replace the vague retry banner
backlog.problem: “Retry needed · reopen the form” does not name the failed record and can persist across pages.
backlog.change: Show the record, unsaved changes and a specific Review / Retry action; separate connection status from save status.
backlog.acceptance: A failed save remains recoverable; successful retry or an explicit discard clears only that record’s warning.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Make failed emails recoverable
backlog.problem: Historical sends include invalid-recipient failures; a failed queued item reached eight attempts.
backlog.change: Validate recipients before queueing; show recipient, subject and source record; classify permanent, temporary and uncertain delivery outcomes.
backlog.acceptance: Invalid addresses fail before send; uncertain delivery is held for review; retry cannot duplicate an already accepted message.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Show all unresolved problems accurately
backlog.problem: Recent failure counts are capped history; unresolved work can fall outside a latest-100 window.
backlog.change: Filter unresolved work before pagination; show total counts, age and date range; group retries for one message.
backlog.acceptance: A deliberately old unresolved item is still visible; ten attempts are not presented as ten unresolved messages.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Use one explicit business timezone
backlog.problem: Today and “current snapshot” labels showed different calendar dates near midnight.
backlog.change: Store timestamps consistently and derive business days in a configured timezone; label reporting periods clearly.
backlog.acceptance: Midnight, daylight-saving changes, month ends and overnight payroll agree across server and browser.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Resolve flagged job relationships
backlog.problem: Two jobs were flagged for missing customer linkage or a billing mode needing review.
backlog.change: Offer a guided review of customer, accepted quote and billing basis with a preview of the impact; keep legitimate jobs without quotes possible.
backlog.acceptance: Reviewed jobs have explicit relationships and billing rules; no quote is silently accepted or financial history rewritten.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Reduce obsolete and duplicate-looking reminders
backlog.problem: Today has a large overdue backlog with repeated-looking customer and receipt reminders.
backlog.change: Group reminders by source; reconcile stable automation keys and stop obsolete reminders; review ambiguous duplicates before merging.
backlog.acceptance: One actionable reminder per source obligation; legitimate separate jobs and quote revisions remain separate.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Repair analytics coverage
backlog.problem: Analytics showed four unavailable comparisons and twelve reports to check.
backlog.change: Guide connection and property selection for each website; explain permissions, reporting lag, last success and recovery action.
backlog.acceptance: All four sites have an explicit connected / partial / unavailable state; comparisons use matching available periods.

backlog.title: Finish employee setup from the warning
backlog.problem: Pending approvals exist while employee/payroll setup is incomplete.
backlog.change: Link the warning directly to account → employee → dated rate setup with a visible checklist.
backlog.acceptance: Approvers can identify missing setup; payroll still refuses incomplete or unapproved hours.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Keep filters and pagination in sync
backlog.problem: Business report date changes do not reset the current page; several states are local-only.
backlog.change: Reset pagination on every filter change and consistently preserve filters in URLs.
backlog.acceptance: Changing dates on page three shows the first matching page; refresh and Back retain the same report.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Unify companies and their contacts
backlog.problem: The same business can appear as a person and a company, splitting history unless relationships are explicit.
backlog.change: Extend existing merge preview with company/contact relationships, primary billing contact and a readable combined history.
backlog.acceptance: Search by person or company finds the same connected account; merging preserves references and audit history.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Make each business event update all dependents once
backlog.problem: Cross-module refresh and idempotency already exist, but journey-level consistency must cover every transition.
backlog.change: Document and test event ownership for quote acceptance, payments, job changes, receipts, time approvals and reversals.
backlog.acceptance: Retries and concurrent tabs create no duplicate job, invoice, reminder or cost; all affected screens refresh.

backlog.title: Expand the relationship review center
backlog.problem: Current health checks help, but each exception needs an understandable repair path.
backlog.change: Show missing, conflicting and historical relationships with evidence and a preview of suggested corrections.
backlog.acceptance: Every repair is permission-checked, audited and reversible where appropriate; names alone never trigger an automatic merge.

backlog.title: Add a consistent connected-record summary
backlog.problem: Users should not have to search another module to continue working on the same customer or job.
backlog.change: Show Customer, Quote, Job, Invoices, Files and Activity in a compact shared header; keep stable readable record numbers.
backlog.acceptance: The linked journey is reachable in one tap per step on desktop and phone; missing links explain the next action.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Use one connected file library per job
backlog.problem: Files, documents, designs and request photos are available in several separate areas.
backlog.change: Unify discovery and references while keeping internal files private; make upload-and-attach completion atomic or recoverable.
backlog.acceptance: A request photo, contract or drawing is discoverable from its customer and job; sharing always names the exact revision and audience.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Make deletion and restoration predictable
backlog.problem: Deletion can affect connected records; current Trash and safeguards should be made easier to understand.
backlog.change: Preview dependencies; distinguish archive, recoverable delete and irreversible purge; restore relationships together when valid.
backlog.acceptance: Restoring a customer or lead recovers valid links without reviving canceled financial actions or exposing private files.

backlog.title: Standardize validation and recovery
backlog.problem: Users have seen raw validation messages and cross-page retry warnings.
backlog.change: Use plain-language field errors, clear required/optional labels, preserved input and consistent conflict recovery.
backlog.acceptance: Blank optional values remain blank; server errors focus the relevant field; slow saves cannot create duplicates.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Create one settings index
backlog.problem: Branding, billing terms, email templates, pricing, marketing and clock policies are spread across modules.
backlog.change: Add a categorized settings home that links to existing controls; explain company defaults and trade overrides.
backlog.acceptance: A user finds a setting by name without losing its role restrictions or creating a second source of truth.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Organize around daily work
backlog.problem: Thirty-three main destinations make the suite powerful but harder to learn.
backlog.change: Use Today, Customers, Jobs, Money and Marketing as primary groups; keep role-based favorites and searchable More.
backlog.acceptance: Every existing destination remains accessible; the employee workspace stays focused and permission-restricted.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Lead with the five most useful actions
backlog.problem: The phone Today page is long and reminders compete with immediate work.
backlog.change: Show urgent work, owner, reason and next action first; group the backlog and make graphs optional below it.
backlog.acceptance: An owner can identify today’s first action without scrolling; all remaining work stays accessible through clear counts.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Use a clear next-action sales list
backlog.problem: Responsive list view exists; duplicate-looking leads and follow-up context can still confuse the workflow.
backlog.change: Emphasize contact, request, owner, next follow-up and connected quote; keep board view optional.
backlog.acceptance: A user can call, assign, schedule a follow-up or open the current quote from one compact card without accidental stage changes.

backlog.title: Make history readable and actionable
backlog.problem: Quotes, invoices, leads and jobs need one understandable story.
backlog.change: Group history by job with a chronological activity option; distinguish invoiced balance from unbilled contract balance.
backlog.acceptance: Every history row opens the correct record; people and company contacts do not hide each other’s work.

backlog.title: Guide quote creation and revision
backlog.problem: The quote builder mixes drafting, saved records, pricing tools and issued revisions.
backlog.change: Use Customer → Scope → Price → Review; separate the issued view; show version, expiry and the current accepted revision.
backlog.acceptance: A saved quote can be reviewed without entering edit mode; manual acceptance retains staff attribution; revisions do not overwrite approvals.

backlog.title: Make job setup a short guided flow
backlog.problem: Quote approval, scheduling, payment readiness and work status are different concepts but appear together.
backlog.change: Ask customer, scope and billing first; show readiness blockers separately from tentative/confirmed dates and active/done work.
backlog.acceptance: Saving harmless settings does not require unexplained exceptions; confirmation shows exact unmet requirements and an explicit override reason if permitted.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Make the task board easy without dragging
backlog.problem: Wide boards and a large overdue backlog are difficult on phones.
backlog.change: Offer My tasks and job-grouped lists with explicit status buttons; add reviewed bulk rescheduling and clear completion feedback.
backlog.acceptance: All task actions work with touch and keyboard; bulk actions show selected records and preserve individual due dates unless changed deliberately.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Use a phone agenda and readiness cues
backlog.problem: Schedule graphs and planning details can obscure the next commitment.
backlog.change: Start with Today / Week agenda, crew, address and readiness; place capacity and hours analysis behind a details view.
backlog.acceptance: Conflicts, leave and unready jobs are visible before confirmation; the same date/status appears on the job and employee view.

backlog.title: Preview what a template will create
backlog.problem: Templates speed up setup but their tasks, materials and assumptions must be understandable.
backlog.change: Group templates by trade and job type; preview generated work, quantities and assumptions before creation.
backlog.acceptance: Changing a template never silently alters an existing job; generated items are traceable to the template version.

backlog.title: Make phone quality a release gate
backlog.problem: Thirty-two main pages fit the tested width, but physical phone and complete interaction checks remain.
backlog.change: Apply the phone checklist to every page, modal, report and customer-facing handoff throughout all phases.
backlog.acceptance: Critical journeys pass at 360, 390 and 430 CSS pixels, landscape, 200% zoom and on physical iPhone/Android devices.

backlog.title: Shorten forms and keep actions reachable
backlog.problem: Phone forms fit, but invoice and contract dialogs expose about twenty controls.
backlog.change: Show essentials first; progressively disclose advanced fields; maintain a safe bottom action area and logical keyboard navigation.
backlog.acceptance: The focused field and validation stay visible above the keyboard; no sticky bar covers content or the final field.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Add an explicit offline job pack
backlog.problem: Field work needs reliable access to approved scope, drawings and measurements when connectivity is poor.
backlog.change: Download a versioned job pack with visible freshness; consider queued internal notes/photos with conflict review.
backlog.acceptance: Offline data clearly names its revision; reconnect cannot silently approve, bill, accept a quote or duplicate uploads.

backlog.title: Make file uploads clear and resilient
backlog.problem: General job files are supported; selection, progress, failures and destination still need a consistent experience.
backlog.change: Offer camera and file library, supported-type guidance, multiple-file progress and retry; handle phone image formats deliberately.
backlog.acceptance: A failed attachment can be retried without duplicate records; uploaded files remain readable and correctly linked after reload.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Optimize the crew’s daily flow
backlog.problem: Employee tools exist but were not exercised live under a worker account in this audit.
backlog.change: Keep My job, directions, timer, checklist and internal files prominent; make corrections and approval status understandable.
backlog.acceptance: A worker sees only permitted assignments; one timer survives reconnect; corrections update approved hours through the required review.

backlog.title: Link design projects to real jobs
backlog.problem: The Studio project list is hardcoded instead of a general job-linked registry.
backlog.change: Create a project registry connected to customer, job, quote and approved design version.
backlog.acceptance: A design can be opened from its job; archived designs remain traceable without crowding the active list.

backlog.title: Create verified manufacturing packs
backlog.problem: The current plant view is a photo-reference model; field-book/cut-list actions exist for the earlier design.
backlog.change: Measure and approve the current build, then generate part drawings, hole centers, radii, hardware and cut lists from that revision.
backlog.acceptance: Every manufacturing dimension has a verified source/tolerance; unmeasured parts are marked incomplete; offline pack and model agree.

backlog.title: Keep design viewing fast and usable
backlog.problem: Detailed 3D can compete with phone memory, battery and small-screen controls.
backlog.change: Measure render cost; load models on demand; add low-detail mode, 2D drawings and clear selected-part controls.
backlog.acceptance: A lower-powered phone can open a useful 2D view when 3D is unavailable; fullscreen controls and selection remain accessible.

backlog.title: Use readable, consistent language and controls
backlog.problem: Dense secondary controls and technical labels make field use harder.
backlog.change: Use consistent English/Spanish labels, visible focus, accessible names, readable contrast and large touch areas; avoid hover-only actions.
backlog.acceptance: Main workflows work by keyboard and screen reader; dates, money and units remain unambiguous in either language.

backlog.title: Explain the contract-to-cash picture
backlog.problem: An invoice balance of zero does not mean the remaining contract is fully billed.
backlog.change: Show Contract, Billed, Collected, Due now and Remaining to bill with definitions and record links.
backlog.acceptance: Drafts, retainage, tax and overlapping figures are distinguished; totals reconcile to their source records.

backlog.title: Guide deposits, progress and final billing
backlog.problem: Billing options and paid-state copy can be confusing even when the calculations are correct.
backlog.change: Start from the linked job; explain the billing stage and available amount; make paid links explicitly view-only.
backlog.acceptance: Deposits reduce the proper obligation; final billing does not double-charge prior invoices; previews reflect sent/paid state.

backlog.title: Keep change orders, credits and reversals traceable
backlog.problem: Every adjustment must propagate without silently rewriting a sent document or payment.
backlog.change: Unify the correction path around explicit source records, permissions, approvals and clear before/after totals.
backlog.acceptance: Partial refunds, voids and approved scope changes update all dependent balances exactly once with an audit trail.

backlog.title: Make receipt capture the fastest path
backlog.problem: Phone expense records sit below a large graph area and a long list.
backlog.change: Put Add receipt, job and category first; compact the summary and make graphs expandable; clarify reimbursable versus job cost.
backlog.acceptance: A user captures a receipt and links it to a job with minimal fields; missing-receipt reminders resolve when the file is attached.

backlog.title: Simplify ordering and partial receiving
backlog.problem: Supplier/customer roles, units and partial receipts must stay explicit.
backlog.change: Use clear Ordered / Received / Remaining steps; show unit conversions, landed cost and the target job or stock location.
backlog.acceptance: Repeated receipt submission adds stock once; partial quantities, returns and supplier files remain traceable.

backlog.title: Make field stock and job costs agree
backlog.problem: Stock, reservations, tools and job usage need separate but connected actions.
backlog.change: Simplify Find → Reserve → Use / Return; distinguish reusable tools from consumed material; consider scanning labels where useful.
backlog.acceptance: A return restores stock/cost correctly; a tool checkout never becomes consumed material; no duplicate PO/expense/job cost.

backlog.title: Explain payroll readiness and corrections
backlog.problem: Approvals, dated rates, overnight work and leave affect pay-period totals.
backlog.change: Use a review checklist with exact missing setup and correction paths; label gross-pay calculations and exports clearly.
backlog.acceptance: Only approved eligible hours enter a closed period; dated rates and later corrections reconcile; do not imply tax filing or payroll remittance.

backlog.title: Show useful profit with data confidence
backlog.problem: Profit is misleading if unrecorded labor, receipts or material costs are treated as zero.
backlog.change: Show expected versus actual margin with missing-cost warnings, committed purchases and drill-through by job.
backlog.acceptance: Unknown costs are labeled unknown; received stock, expenses and labor are not counted twice.

backlog.title: Turn page performance into a short action list
backlog.problem: Graphs already exist; users need confidence, reasons and the next optimization.
backlog.change: Rank pages by qualified inquiries, engagement and search opportunity; show sample size, date coverage and source.
backlog.acceptance: Every recommendation links to its evidence and an improvement task; unavailable data never appears as a real zero.

backlog.title: Verify requests and attachments end to end
backlog.problem: Prior lost-photo problems make attachment delivery a critical regression scenario.
backlog.change: Trace site request → lead/customer → files → notification; add receipt confirmation and a recoverable incomplete-submission state.
backlog.acceptance: Each site accepts supported files; the team can open them from the lead/job; email attachment or secure-link behavior matches its documented policy.

backlog.title: Make approval and payment journeys consistent
backlog.problem: Public quote, invoice and preview handoffs must show the correct approved version and status.
backlog.change: Use clear read-only / awaiting approval / accepted / paid states; keep quote approval separate from design approval.
backlog.acceptance: Expired, revoked and revised links behave correctly; private internal files never leak through a public link.

backlog.title: Connect completion, reviews and portfolio
backlog.problem: Completion should gather final files and follow-up work without automatic public sharing.
backlog.change: Add a completion checklist for punch list, final invoice, handover, customer feedback and approved portfolio assets.
backlog.acceptance: A review request respects communication settings; only explicitly approved photos/details reach a public site.

backlog.title: Measure improvement work through outcomes
backlog.problem: Campaign clicks and website changes need a connection to qualified work.
backlog.change: Link campaign/SEO tasks to the affected pages, hypothesis, dates and resulting leads; distinguish attribution from proof of causation.
backlog.acceptance: Source site remains distinct from the trade that fulfills a job; reporting handles unknown/referral sources honestly.

backlog.title: Show communication in the customer’s context
backlog.problem: Email templates, sent history and failed automation are separate from the record being discussed.
backlog.change: Expose the relevant thread/history on customer and job records; name provider-accepted, delivered if known, bounced and failed states accurately.
backlog.acceptance: Users can verify which version and attachments were sent; reply context is preserved; no unsupported inbox-delivery claim.

backlog.title: Expand connected-journey regression gates
backlog.problem: CI and regression tests already exist; passing them does not cover every live data pattern or phone interaction.
backlog.change: Add the audit’s reproduced failures and full lifecycle journeys to existing tests, including roles, reversals and concurrent tabs.
backlog.acceptance: A release is blocked by any failed critical journey; tests use isolated data and never send real customer messages.

backlog.title: Capture actionable, privacy-aware errors
backlog.problem: A generic failure message gives little help in identifying the affected record or release.
backlog.change: Record safe error codes, route, operation and release version; offer a copyable support reference without dumping sensitive payloads.
backlog.acceptance: One failure can be traced from UI to server safely; alerts distinguish a single bad record from a service outage.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Measure queries and refresh only what changed
backlog.problem: Shared cache invalidation, indexes and pagination already exist; improvements need measurements.
backlog.change: Baseline slow routes and query counts, then target expensive joins, capped lists and broad refreshes.
backlog.acceptance: Representative large datasets remain usable; pagination never changes totals; unrelated screens do not refetch for every event.

backlog.title: Set and enforce phone performance budgets
backlog.problem: Routes are lazy-loaded, but large workflows and models still need real-device profiling.
backlog.change: Measure first useful content, input delay, memory and transfer sizes; defer nonessential graphs/models and size image variants.
backlog.acceptance: Baseline and agreed budgets are recorded per critical page; the phone stays responsive during uploads, graphs and model viewing.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Refactor large modules and prove dead code before removal
backlog.problem: Large finance, contracts, leads and job files increase change risk; allowJs does not type-check every JavaScript path.
backlog.change: Split around tested business responsibilities; gradually type critical JSX/hooks; inventory imports, routes and asset references before removal.
backlog.acceptance: Each deletion has usage evidence and a passing build/journey check; legacy links get redirects; no customer data is deleted as cleanup.

backlog.title: Practice recovery as well as downloading backups
backlog.problem: Backup and restore evidence already exist; recovery needs a regular isolated drill.
backlog.change: Verify database and attachment manifests, schema migration paths and rollback procedure on a disposable environment.
backlog.acceptance: A restored sample reproduces linked records and files; failed integrity checks prevent deployment or destructive cleanup.

backlog.title: Verify permissions through every entry point
backlog.problem: Role restrictions and device controls exist; UI visibility is only one layer.
backlog.change: Test owner/manager/worker access on APIs, search, files and public links; review session expiry and available stronger sign-in options.
backlog.acceptance: A worker cannot retrieve finance or another worker’s private data through a copied URL; session recovery preserves unsaved work safely.

backlog.title: Keep queues observable and retry-safe
backlog.problem: Durable retries exist; operators need a reliable view of stuck, exhausted and uncertain work.
backlog.change: Add worker heartbeat, age, grouped attempts and explicit recovery reasons while preserving frozen payload/idempotency rules.
backlog.acceptance: Restart and concurrent workers process each business effect once; operator actions cannot unknowingly resend old financial communications.
backlog.status: Implementation started; integration, browser and full release checks pending

backlog.title: Use one metric definition everywhere
backlog.problem: Snapshot counts, date-filtered flows and overlapping financial totals can look comparable when they are not.
backlog.change: Publish short metric definitions and shared period rules; preserve the same filters in chart drill-through and exports.
backlog.acceptance: Chart, detail list and exported totals reconcile; comparisons exclude unavailable periods and separate snapshots from period activity.

backlog.title: Add help where decisions are made
backlog.problem: Technical labels and scattered settings increase training time.
backlog.change: Use short examples and “What happens next?” explanations; add feedback that includes safe page/version context.
backlog.acceptance: A new user can complete the main workflows without memorizing internal IDs or reading a long manual.

backlog.title: Review orphaned files and retention safely
backlog.problem: Abandoned uploads and repeated assets may consume storage; actual waste is not yet quantified.
backlog.change: Build a read-only usage report; identify references across live, archived and trash records before offering cleanup.
backlog.acceptance: Every candidate has age, size and references; backups are verified; recoverable retention precedes permanent purge.

backlog.title: Use staged rollouts with visible release status
backlog.problem: A successful deployment should be verified through the user’s important workflows.
backlog.change: Add a small release checklist, schema compatibility check, safe smoke tests and a known rollback path; show the deployed version to support.
backlog.acceptance: Each release has recorded validation, backup status and rollback instructions; an app refresh cannot strand an unsaved draft.
